<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows ten carbon signals. Signals in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm) are at 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, and 14.05 ppm. Each distinct low‑field carbon corresponds to a CH₃ carbon, giving six methyl groups in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
